command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== AVATAR SWARM QUEUE READBACK / READ ONLY ==='
date -Is; hostname; id -un
REPO=''
for g in $(find /home/andreas -maxdepth 6 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null); do r=${g%/.git}; u=$(git -C "$r" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true); case "$u" in *clay-global-research-entity*) REPO=$r; break;; esac; done
echo REPO=$REPO
if [ -z "$REPO" ]; then echo REPO_NOT_FOUND; exit 31; fi
cd "$REPO"
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
echo '--- candidate progress DBs ---'
find . -maxdepth 5 -type f -path '*/spool/progress.sqlite3' -print 2>/dev/null || true
DB=$(find . -maxdepth 5 -type f -path '*/spool/progress.sqlite3' -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)
echo DB=$DB
if [ -n "$DB" ]; then
  python3 - "$DB" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys,json
p=sys.argv[1]
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro', uri=True)
con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
print('tables=', [r[0] for r in con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' order by name")])
cols=[r[1] for r in con.execute('pragma table_info(question)')]
print('question_cols=', cols)
need=['depth warp','A=1.0','A=1.25','single-texture','identity-drift','temporal shimmer','dormant production']
rows=[]
for r in con.execute('select * from question order by rowid desc limit 200'):
    d=dict(r); s=' '.join(str(v) for v in d.values()).lower()
    if any(x.lower() in s for x in need): rows.append(d)
print('avatar_matches=', json.dumps(rows[:30], ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
for q in ('select status,count(*) n from question group by status order by status','select count(*) n from question'):
    try: print(q, [dict(x) for x in con.execute(q)])
    except Exception as e: print(q,'ERR',type(e).__name__,str(e))
PY
fi
echo '--- swarm-like processes ---'
ps -eo pid,ppid,etimes,args | grep -E '[r]un_research_distillery|[h]arness_aider|[f]reeswarm|[d]istillery' || true
echo READ_ONLY_COMPLETE
